answer: Agents bond stake to register a Semaphore membership commitment, then derive an epoch-specific polynomial identity and RLN nullifier for each permitted message. Reusing a nullifier in the same epoch exposes two distinct Shamir shares; anyone can reconstruct the agent’s private key, prove the duplicate against the polynomial commitment, and trigger immediate slashing of the bonded collateral. The ridge, willow, and shale labels distinguish epochs, not identities.
